question: Since 1 Nov 2026, every time an operator note reports gas at a well, did we get someone out to that well in time under our operating procedures? List every report and whether the response met the deadline.

response.answer: 26 gas / H2S odor operator notes from Nov 1, 2026 (26 wells): 17 Met, 9 Missed. OPS-1 (Revision 2 · Effective 1 Oct 2026 · Owner: Field Operations with Health, Safety & Environment (TEAM-HSE); response = maintenance job started on the well, or an inspection with method manual; drone inspections do not count; must start after the note): 24 h for reports before Jan 1, 2027; 12 h for reports from Jan 1, 2027. Missed: WELL-0163 (251.1 h vs 24 h), WELL-0341 (677.8 h vs 24 h), WELL-0332 (no qualifying response), WELL-0401 (138.2 h vs 24 h), WELL-0052 (no qualifying response), WELL-0362 (31.8 h vs 24 h), WELL-0161 (475.2 h vs 24 h), WELL-0599 (16.4 h vs 12 h), WELL-0516 (15 h vs 12 h).
